concerns.text: T002 (ReferenceValidator) and T003 (Manifest Validator) are scheduled in Phase 0, but they depend on artifacts (contracts/PaperManifest.schema.yaml, research.md) that are not produced by any preceding task in this document. T006 (Schema generation) is listed in Phase 2, creating a circular dependency where Phase 0 tasks cannot execute before Phase 2 tasks complete.

T020 (Update ReproResult schema) is marked [P] (parallel-safe), but it modifies the schema file that T005 (ingest.py) and T013 (model_runner.py) depend on. If T005 runs before T020 completes, it will validate against an outdated schema. T020 must be strictly ordered before any task consuming ReproResult.

T017 (Sensitivity Analysis) is marked [P] but depends on T006 (Schema) and T007 (Metrics). While T006/T007 are in Phase 2, T017 also implicitly depends on T013 (Model Runner) to have a baseline model to sweep. The current ordering allows T017 to be scheduled before T013, violating the producer-consumer flow for the model artifact.

T001b and T003b are marked [P] but T003b (linting checks) requires the project structure created by T001. While T001 is a setup task, the explicit dependency T001 -> T003b should be noted or T003b should be moved to a 'Post-Setup' phase to ensure the directory tree exists before running `black --check .`.
